name: Kunoichi
subtitle: Shadow Dancer
description: Throw poisonous tricks at your foes and cast tricks to control the battle.
lore: The kunoichi are women who practice specific methods of the shadow arts. By taking advantage of cultural expectations regarding gender roles, they infiltrate locations where even other shinobi have difficulty. Through disguise, deception, and sometimes their mere presence, they are masters of gathering intelligence, and should their true allegiances be discovered, they are equally as adept at combat as their brethren.

skills.description: Place [mechanic:vanish] on this hero for 1 turn, then has a 60% chance to place [mechanic:vulnerable-i] on enemies under [mechanic:acid] for 2 turns.
